name: Greater elemental
description: A wild greater elemental that ignited Ashling's fires and later appears as a great white steed with unquenchable fire; she absorbs its power.

description_citations.text: "Ashling". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashling begins a pilgrimage through Lorwyn, searching for the greater elemental of her birth.
timeline.quote: In 4520 AR , Ashling journeyed on a pilgrimage through Lorwyn

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Pilgrimage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brigid drenches Ashling, nearly killing her; the greater elemental appears, rekindles her fire and sets Colfenor ablaze.
timeline.quote: A surge of energy from the elemental's blessing rekindled her fire and set Colfenor ablaze, obliterating the yew.

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Pilgrimage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashling ascends a step on the Path of Flame, able to will her flame white, and leaves in flame with the elemental after helping free the giants.
timeline.quote: she also ascended a step on the Path of Flame, being able to will her red flame to a white one

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Abused and angry". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashling resolves to claim the elemental's power for herself rather than seek its guidance.
timeline.quote: instead to claim its power, fully, for herself

citation.text: "Ashling", section "The Ember Fell Monastery". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Great Aurora ritual Ashling seizes the elemental's power and the sapling's knowledge by force, absorbing them; some energy goes to Maralen.
timeline.quote: she seized the unsuspecting elemental's power and the sapling's knowledge by force

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Destiny fulfilled". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: she comes to resent it and absorbs its power
relations.quote: The elemental was absorbed by her

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Destiny fulfilled". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
